items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Because I played in the WPN with him. ... I come and meet Luis Dumaine, Joe Howard. Oh, man, I knew all them guys.

ctx.x: Papa Joe, uh, I can't call his last name. He was a trumpet player with Louis Armstrong when Louis Armstrong was on that boat. Joe Howard. Joe Howard. Joe Howard. Yeah. Because I played in the WPN with him. Yeah.
With him. And then they called him Papa Joe.
